symptom: `mxcli describe module Banking -p app.mpr` prints only `create or modify module Banking;` and its module roles, although `describe --help` says "module  Describe a module (all contents)"; the full output needs `-c "describe module Banking with all"`, documented only in the changelog
cause: describeMDLCommand maps MODULE to a plain DESCRIBE MODULE (module + roles, by design of the MDL statement); the help line described WITH ALL, which the subcommand had no way to request
fix: Added `--all` (applyDescribeAll appends WITH ALL; refused on any other type) and made the help say what plain describe module prints
insight: Fixed the help, not the default: a plain describe module matches `-c "describe module X"` and existing scripts that describe a module to get its header, and WITH ALL has known open gaps (#1421 omits doc types, #1425 truncates at 10k lines silently), so silently switching the default would trade a wrong help line for silently incomplete output. When a subcommand's help and the MDL statement disagree, check which one the -c form agrees with before choosing which to change.
